claims.claim: Welcome to Bloxburg was created on November 4, 2014, by the Bloxburg Development group.
claims.notes: Read from Roblox's public games API on Nov 26, 2026: created 2014-11-04T03:31:28Z, creator Bloxburg Development (Group, verified badge), max 12 players per server.

claims.claim: Welcome to Bloxburg ranked #36 on the most-played list with 35,086 playing at 21:03 UTC, November 26, 2026; 24-hour peak 37,940; +52.0% change in the last 24 hours.

claims.claim: The Winter event in Welcome to Bloxburg started November 26, 2026 at 1:00 PM UTC and ends January 11, 2027 at 9:00 AM UTC.
claims.notes: abusetime.dev Bloxburg event page, read Nov 26, 2026 ~21:05 UTC.

claims.claim: The Winter event introduces the Skating Spotlight minigame and Snow Storms that boost earnings while plowing snow.
claims.notes: abusetime.dev event description; PlayTime changelog confirms the same ('Skating Spotlight minigame, Snow Storms which give you a money boost when Snow Plowing').

claims.claim: The winter market returns for the Winter event, with new items including a Winter Carriage vehicle (B$250).
claims.notes: PlayTime changelog: 'the winter market will return'; Robuilds Winter Update item showcase (Nov 26, 2026) lists the Winter Carriage vehicle at B$250 among the new items.
